name: git-status
description: A status line below the prompt with the changes and unpushed commits of the session's git repository — local only, no fetch.

branch.title: Branch to compare
branch.description: Empty compares the current branch with its upstream. Name one (such as develop) to always compare that branch with its upstream, whatever is checked out.

nestedRepos.title: Include nested repositories
nestedRepos.description: Also check folders directly inside the session's repository that are git repositories of their own (such as ios/ and android/).

extraRepos.title: Extra repositories
extraRepos.description: Paths of further repositories to check in every session; ~ stands for your home folder.
